Professional scanned painted-paper appearance, believable pigment settling and real-looking paper tooth, not CGI, icons, repeated recoloured shapes or digital-gradient bars. generation.prompt: Create an original excellent traditional watercolour still-life study, high-resolution 3:2 landscape, neutral flat scan-like reproduction on fine warm white cold-pressed paper. A simple off-white ceramic jug stands left of centre, roughly x=43%, top=20%, bottom=77%, one believable handle on its left; two modest pears sit at x=65%, y=68% and x=78%, y=75% on a light tabletop. Quiet muted blue-grey background begins behind the objects; main light from upper left preserves white jug highlights and creates a modest connected cast shadow under/right of objects. Clear large light, middle and dark relationships, more importance to shape grouping than detail. Pears subdued yellow-green/ochre, jug translucent blue-grey shadow, no photographic gloss. Believable traditional transparent paint, organic found/lost edges, controlled layers, subtle appropriate granulation, paper white, quiet hand variation. Convincing drawing and proportions, no distorted handles or extra fruit. The viewpoint and object positions must be simple enough for later matching three-value plans. Not a photograph of objects, flat vector, cartoon, glossy CGI or fantasy illustration. No text, labels, framing, tools, signature or watermark. Subject is invented original artwork, no artist imitation.

generation.prompt: Original specialist watercolour teaching comparison, 3:2 horizontal flat scan-like painted paper, no text, no labels. On subtly textured warm white watercolour paper place TWO large separate blue-grey rectangular wash specimens side by side with a broad clean white gutter. LEFT specimen is one connected light-middle-value transparent wash with the individual horizontal passes mingling so no hard internal bands remain; slightly organic perimeter, restrained pigment settling. RIGHT specimen is same-sized same-colour similar-value wash in three broad horizontal passes where two joins set before connection: narrow irregular darker horizontal tide/lap lines remain at the joins, visible but natural, not drawn black divider lines. These are dried painted results illustrating continuous versus interrupted wet-edge handling; no active shiny water bead, no hands or brushes. Authentic paper tooth, subtle blue granulation, believable dilute pigment distribution. No smooth digital gradients, vectors, geometric icons, unrelated blooms, dramatic light/shadow or decorative background. Maintain readable value similarity so the comparison is about joining, not a darker whole panel. Professional restrained adult education specimen.
